title: Chapter 1147
paragraphs: Chapter 1147
Final Chapter. Pilgrimage and Regression
September 9th, 1806.
The first banquet hosted by the 60th patriarch of Runcandel, Jin Runcandel, was held.

Even more people visited the Garden of Swords than at last year's patriarch succession ceremony. The pillars of Runcandel and the Vamel Alliance accepted challengers just the same, and people settled the grudges they had built up against each other over the past year.
"It's a grand festival this year too."
"I know. But it's so disappointing that Young Master Jin isn't here."
It was Quikantel and Enya. The main figures of the Vamel Alliance were sitting in the VIP seats of the banquet hall, watching the people entering the sparring grounds.
"A Runcandel banquet, and one that also celebrates the patriarch's birthday, yet the man himself isn't here. It is strange."
"It would have been perfect if Young Master Jin and Valeria had shown their faces even for a moment."
"They have things they must do, so it can't be helped. They must miss us too."
"Should we try communicating?"
"I tried a little while ago. It seems they can't receive it."
"Ugh, what a shame... To think that even communication doesn't work well most of the time. It's also sad to think about how hard a time they both must be having."
It wasn't just the banquet that Jin and Valeria had missed.
Most of their comrades had last seen the two a year ago, on the day Chiron's armor and weapons, excluding Barisada, were enshrined in Runcandel's mausoleum.
"Dante, have you and Veradin received any contact from our patriarch either?"
"That's right, Lady Mary."
It was Dante and Mary.
Their comrades looked at the matching rings on the two's ring fingers. They were engagement rings.
"It's really strange... when on earth did you two get so close?"
At Quikantel's question, Dante cleared his throat and tried to change the subject, but Mary bared her teeth in a grin.

"They say love blooms even in the midst of war. Isn't it something like that? With Dante, I could spend my whole life fighting and he'd be able to withstand my sword as much as I want, so there's no better husband material."
"That's right, sister! But Lord Dante, run away, even now!"
"That's right, hurry and run away, even now, Lord Dante...!"

As the Tona brothers from the opposite table joined the conversation, Mary was about to smack their heads but became conscious of the surrounding gazes. She couldn't show a flag-bearer beating up other flag-bearers at a banquet. The Tona brothers laughed, k-heh heh, and stuck their tongues out at Mary.
"Haha, my dear younger brothers. See you later?"
"Oh, so scary."
"Scary, so scary. But we've gotten quite strong from training with Father too."
"Now, it'll be tough for even you, sister, to face the two of us at the same time."
Dante gave an awkward laugh at the familiar situation. In truth, the Tona brothers would express their affection for Mary when they drank with Dante separately.
"Ahem, ahem... Lady Mary will not be facing the two of you alone."
"Kuh, Dante, you cute thing! To say such sweet words. I like it. Say it again."
"Lady Mary, to say the same thing again is a bit..."
"Ah, come on, again. Just once, please."
"Hmm... Lady Mary will not be facing the two of you alone..."
Their comrades shrugged as they watched the heartily laughing Mary and the blushing Dante.
"By the way, I don't know if the youngest and Valeria can come to your wedding."
This time it was Luntia, who had just come out of the sparring grounds after beating down all the challengers.
"Hah? Sister, that's absurd. You think the youngest would miss my wedding?"
"Officially, today's banquet is a bigger event than your wedding."
"Dammit, that's true. But that's by our Runcandel standards. By Vamel Alliance standards, isn't our wedding a bigger event?"
"That's true too. I hope we can see their faces thanks to your wedding."
"Dante, if by any chance the youngest doesn't come, our wedding is off. We have to have it on a day the youngest can definitely come."
"Of course, it must be so."
"I'm kidding. Whether they come or not, the protagonists of that day are you and I, so of course we have to do it as planned."
"I was being serious."
"Wh-really? The protagonists are us, I'm telling you."
"Actually, I was kidding. I'm sorry. As a sign of my apology, I will sing the song I mentioned last time for you when we're alone later today."
"You really are cute!"
Their comrades let out a chuckle as they watched Dante and Mary go off to dance.

"When I briefly got in touch with Jin last time, he was a bit surprised to hear the news late, but then he quickly accepted it, saying he had a feeling it would happen. Enya, it's not like Jin and Valeria really can't come to their wedding, right?"
"I don't think so, Yuria."
"At times like this, it's a bit of a shame that the authority of foresight is gone."
"Yuria, you shouldn't say such things even as a joke."
"Ah, I understand, Mother. It was a mistake. But I didn't say it because I miss them... I said it because I feel sorry for Aunt Gilly."
At the mention of Gilly's name, the comrades' expressions turned solemn.

She had become noticeably gaunt over the past year. Even at today's banquet, she was being treated as the guest of highest honor and receiving many people's praise, but she spent more time alone in the room she used to use than in the banquet hall.
Even now, Gilly must be staring blankly at the sky outside the window.
"This won't do. Pinte, Kou, I'm going to go check on Aunt Gilly."
"Alright, go on. Still, when Gilly is with you all, she tends to smile more naturally."
"It must remind her of when the head was young. All kids have their similarities. She'd probably also be reminded of Murakan playing with the kids."
As Eltiot spoke, watching the children run off, his comrades nodded.

"It's a cruel fate, but one that can't be called cruel. I hope the time of hardship Gilly is enduring ends soon. It's already been two years since the world was restored. It's a short time for long-lived beings, but it's by no means a short time for humans. Even more so if you're waiting while missing someone dearly..."
As he said, it had already been two years.
As peaceful days tend to do, time was flowing by like suddenly growing children.
Dante and Mary's wedding was to have a private ceremony first at the Garden of Swords, and then a public ceremony in the Empire.
Naturally, only the family's vassals and the members of the Vamel Alliance attended the private ceremony.
"Dante."
"Speak, Mary."

"You must have had a date you wanted to choose for the wedding too, so thank you for following my opinion. We've been living together for over half a year already, but it feels strange to be having a wedding. I miss my brother, Diphus."
May 22nd. Four years ago today was the day Diphus had passed away with a piece of the Evil God's authority.
"I miss my grandfather too. May is a meaningful month for me as well. It was in May that I had a drink with Jin in front of my grandfather who had become light."
Now, the light left by Ron Hairan no longer existed in the Sword Emperor Castle. He had realized that his duty of protection was over when the world was restored and had chosen to return to nature.

"Yes, I was thinking of my father too. Probably our father and Lord Ron are watching us from somewhere. My brother Diphus must be stuck in between them. I wonder if he's adjusted well to our father, who has become tolerant and gentle."
"Mary and your family adjusted quickly, so he probably has. I'm more worried about my grandfather. I'm sure he still thinks of Lord Chiron as a bit of a stranger."
"Haha, that's probably true. Well, it's time now. Let's go, to get married."
"Give me your hand. I want to go out holding it."
As the door opened, the cheers of their comrades and the family's knights could be heard. The two waved to them and searched for Jin's face.
"There he is, Jin! Youngest, Valeria! It's been a long time! Right, you have to come to our wedding."
"You've come, my friends...!"
Jin and Valeria were sitting in the very front and center, blessing the couple who were about to become husband and wife.
However, unlike their other comrades, they weren't very dressed up. A light coat and robe that bore the traces of a long journey, but what was important was the fact that they had come.
"Congratulations, Sister Mary. Congratulations, Dante."
"You two look good together."
Jin, as the patriarch, went up to the platform and gave a congratulatory speech for the two, and Valeria officiated their vows with recording magic.
"I'm sorry, I don't think I'll be able to stay for the public ceremony."

"What is there to be sorry about, my friend? On the contrary, we are sorry to you. I will live happily with Mary and take better care of our surroundings by as much as your share, so don't worry and go back."
"That's right, youngest. Yona is doing a surprisingly great job as acting patriarch."
"Hee, did you talk about me? That's right, I'm doing a great job as acting patriarch. Because... there's nothing to do!"
"Yona, you said you missed Jin so much, so look at him as much as you can. There's a high chance you won't be able to see him for a long time again."
In fact, Yona had already seen Jin and Valeria about five or six times.
The position of the 60th acting patriarch of Runcandel was one with a lot of time, and Yona was the best at finding people in the world, excluding the recording magician Valeria.

However, Yona hadn't told her siblings and comrades about Jin and Valeria. Because if they knew that the two were spending every day as arduously as a war, everyone would worry. In fact, Jin and Valeria were always so exhausted that they had never noticed Yona watching them and leaving.
"Hee, it's not good for either side to worry about something they don't have to."
"Huh?"
"It's just something that suddenly came to mind, Sister Luna. It's so nice to be able to talk to the youngest after a long time, isn't it?"
"Of course. Are you two eating your meals well while you're traveling?"
"There's no way we'd starve, Sister Luna."
"To be honest, I didn't really understand why everyone asks if we're eating well. Now I get it. No matter how strong you are, that's the first thing to worry about."
However, none of his siblings or comrades held onto Jin for long. It wasn't like he could stay for very long anyway, and his comrades hadn't forgotten who needed Jin the most right now.
"Gilly."
"Young Master."
Jin looked into Gilly's eyes and gave a bitter smile.
Jin and Valeria. The reason the two couldn't be with their comrades even after the fight was all over was, of course, Murakan and Misha.
"Gilly... please wait just a little longer."
"To be honest, it's true that not having Lord Murakan and not being able to see you, Young Master, makes me feel achingly empty and lonely every day. But I... can wait as long as it takes."
Gilly said in a calm voice and gently embraced Jin.

"So please don't live every day as if you're being chased by something. It won't be a long time for Lord Murakan and Lady Misha, so I just have to live while cultivating my own life. It hurts my heart so much to see your face so gaunt. If you're tired, come home and rest anytime."
"Yeah, Gilly. I'll come to see you a little more often."
"I didn't mean for you to come to see me often. I was saying that I hope you and Valeria would take better care of yourselves."
"I know. But I still want to say that."
"I've baked strawberry pies for the first time in a long while. I've also made a lot of your favorite sandwiches, so don't forget them when you leave."
A banquet was held on September 9th, 1808 as well.

This time too, Jin and Valeria did not attend. However, since Jin and Valeria had been returning home once every two months since Mary and Dante's wedding to spend a few hours before leaving again, their comrades were a little less disappointed than before.

It was the same on September 9th, 1809, and September 9th, 1810. But their comrades held the banquet without Jin and Valeria every year just the same, trying not to get used to it. So that they could get used to it from the moment they returned.
In 1811, the Blue Wind Emperor Eltiot passed away. His time was up. Jin and Valeria attended his funeral and sent him off with their comrades.
"What has happened once can never be undone. That is why a moment, a memory, is a wind that blows forever."

"We are all bound to scatter into the crumbs of the world someday, but in a corner of eternity, our memories are always engraved. I love you, my disciple. And my friends. I will now scatter first to meet the brothers I have buried in my heart."

Vahn and Luna, as a descendant and a disciple respectively, recited Eltiot's last words. On their way to leave again, Jin and Valeria recalled those last words over and over again. In a corner of eternity, our memories are always engraved.
Thus, seven, eight, nine years passed since the day the world was restored...
And ten years had passed, and it was the year 1814.
September 9th, the day the Runcandel banquet was held every year. Today too, the stars of Runcandel and the Vamel Alliance had gathered at the Garden of Swords.
They accepted the challenges of the martial artists, caught up, and waited for Jin and Valeria, still trying not to get used to it.
However, one person.
Gilly, unlike last year, was not sitting in the VIP seats of the Garden of Swords. Nor was she alone in the room she used to share with Jin and Murakan, staring out the window.
An old inn in the Mitel Kingdom. She was heading there with a basket in one hand.
The inn was not open for business today. But when Gilly knocked on the door, Jin and Valeria opened it from inside.
"You're here, Gilly."
Gilly stepped inside and looked around the inn.
"Young Master, this place is..."

Her throat was choked, and the words wouldn't come out easily. Gilly was remembering a day in 1790, twenty-four years ago. The memory of that day, which she could never forget even if another ten, a hundred years passed from now, was being drawn as clearly as if it were yesterday.
"That's right, it's that inn. You know, right? Let's go to the third floor."
Gilly's shoulders were trembling as she climbed the stairs one step at a time. Gilly felt that Jin and Valeria's backs were trembling too.
The room on the third floor with the best sunlight was waiting for them, looking surprisingly the same as it had back then.
The only difference was the fact that Jin and Valeria, who had arrived first, had a small ball of light floating in the middle of the room.
"I'm sorry it took so long, Gilly. The words 'I'm sorry'... are finally coming out of my mouth."
"Don't say that, Young Master. Please don't say you're sorry..."
Gilly put down the basket and covered her mouth with both her hands. Her wet eyes sparkled. What if this is a dream? What if this moment is a dream again? Such feelings were flowing down her cheeks.
"It's not... a dream, is it?"
"It's not. This moment, I really wanted to show it to you."
A ball of light, shimmering innocently.
For the past ten years, Jin and Valeria had been away from their loved ones to gather this light. Finding the records of Murakan and Misha flowing on the light, holding onto them, embracing them...
Finally, the place where the most intense record of Murakan remained was this inn.

Twenty-four years ago, on their way from Storm Castle, when Murakan had almost turned into a cat due to Jin's prank, the inn where Gilly had first met Murakan, where she had formed the unofficial trio of Runcandel with Jin.
Soon, Jin created a shadow energy on his palm, exactly the same size as the light in front of him.
That was the last of the spiritual energy left in this world.
"Now, if we let this flow into the light, our guardian dragons will return. Well then... I'll begin."
The shimmering shadow energy on Jin's hand was seen to slowly scatter and crumble, approaching the light.
The light bubbled for a while. Then it split in half and became two black cats.
"Nya? Nyaa?"
"Hiss, kyaaak!"
Huh, what's this?
You idiot, we're back!
Those were the first words the newly formed siblings exchanged. Murakan was slapped on the cheek by Misha's paw and snapped to his senses.
Then he transformed into a human and embraced everyone in sight.
Misha deliberately didn't transform into a human right away and went up to the desk, watching the people hugging each other.
Of course, she wanted to hug Jin, Valeria, and Strawberry Pie too, but she couldn't stand the thought of touching Murakan. Anyway, there would be many opportunities to hug each other from now on.
"Strawberry Pie! Kid...! Historian!"
"Murakan! Murakan, you bastard. It's really you, right? Right?"
"Yeah, it's me! And you're you, right, kid!"
"You've been through a lot... fighting, and coming back. It's been ten years since I could say this."
"Strawberry Pie, I will never leave you again. I will never go anywhere without you again. I will always be by your side, always!"
The people who had been hugging for a long while stood up.
And Jin and Murakan looked at each other. The two, who had grinned, soon opened their mouths as if by promise.

"I am Murakan. Solderet's proxy, his close friend, and the last descendant of the first being created from shadow. As per the thousand-year promise, from today on, I will be with you. State your name."

A serious voice, with no trace of the child-like crying from just a moment ago, was heard. Jin, just like on the day he had first met Murakan at the age of seven, barely suppressed his trembling heart and answered.
"I am Jin Runcandel. The thirteenth of Runcandel, the last-born child."
The pilgrimage was over, and the regression had come to an end. It was time to go home.
It was time to enjoy life together.
<The End>
